binding_rule: Every series MUST be run with free estimator + phase-scramble/scrambled-G4 nulls first. discovery_claim_allowed only when free and not scrambled. Preconditioned lock is secondary labeled compatibility only.
change_log: 2026-07-27 initial expanded observatories; 2026-08-01 added INTEGRAL/SPI 511 keV and PhysioNet EEG formal entries; results/ convention noted.

observatories.name: LIGO
observatories.preferred_products: O3 second-trend auxiliary channels (1 Hz RMS)
observatories.sampling_notes: Second-trend data already 1 Hz; ideal for ~540 s searches. Full set ~61 GB; fetch individual channels.

observatories.name: Virgo
observatories.preferred_products: Strain segments (downsample) and available auxiliary/DQ channels
observatories.sampling_notes: High-rate strain needs downsampling to ≤1 Hz for long continuous segments.

observatories.name: NANOGrav
observatories.preferred_products: Post-fit residuals (ASCII, full and epoch-averaged, whitened/un-whitened)
observatories.sampling_notes: Irregular cadence (days). Convert to evenly sampled residual vector before R-FFT. Native band is nanohertz; 539.9 s is a control/super-harmonic check.

observatories.name: EHT / M87*
observatories.access: CyVerse Data Commons polarised visibility releases + papers (2017/2018/2021)
observatories.preferred_products: Proxy light curves or multi-year polarity/EVPA monitoring
observatories.sampling_notes: Sparse VLBI campaigns. Continuous 1 Hz series do not exist. Multi-year polarity flips relevant to 539.9-day claims only after explicit proxy construction.

observatories.name: PhysioNet EEG
observatories.preferred_products: Long continuous multi-hour recordings (decimate from 256 Hz)
observatories.sampling_notes: Typical 256 Hz; one-hour segments contain only ~6–7 cycles of 539.9 s. Free peaks commonly land in EEG band. Secondary G4 metrics stay compatibility only.
observatories.status: converter and one live CHB-MIT run performed (free peak ~32 Hz; secondary non-significant)

observatories.name: INTEGRAL/SPI 511 keV
observatories.access: A&A papers (Yoneda et al. 2025, Siegert & Yoneda 2026) + INTEGRAL archive
observatories.preferred_products: Time-binned flux light curves (if constructed); spatial maps alone are not spectral claims
observatories.sampling_notes: Primarily spatial. High-latitude hotspots and possible 2–3× higher rate reported. Free-first required only if evenly sampled time series available.

datasets.note: Replace with real trajectory residual when available

results_convention: All free-first run outputs (JSON preferred) under RFFT_datasets/results/ (local) and mirrored to Drive / GitHub R-FFT/results/
